frozen_cli.wall_p50_observed_difference_note: the difference between two adjacent samples of the same session, not an effect size and not a causal claim

unpacked_zip.wall_p50_observed_difference_note: the difference between two adjacent samples of the same session, not an effect size and not a causal claim

method.denominators: both configurations are measured in the same session, with the same scenarios and the same number of attempts per scenario, so the denominators are equal. There is only one session; no attempt of one configuration is compared with an attempt of another session.
method.description: The shipped self-extracting yt-dlp bundle against the upstream unpacked Linux artifact of the same release, with an identical argument set.
method.diagnostics_method: the toolchain probe of the shipped resolver: --verbose --simulate with an unsupported scheme; it exits before any network request
method.diagnostics_note: the diagnostics of the shipped toolchain probe were re-parsed from the excerpts stored in this report after the parser was corrected; the excerpts are the raw measurement data
method.extraction_method: paired extractions per scenario with an identical argument set, serialized, interleaved; the head/tail range probe runs outside the measured window
method.interpretation: The differences between the two binaries are an observation on one machine, not a causal claim. The sample is small, the first launch of each binary has a different page-cache state than the later ones, and the two binaries are not executed from an identical machine state. Adjacent percentiles must not be read as an effect size.
method.manifest_exclusion: Both binaries received identical audio-only controls, not the final production vector: no HIGH bitrate preference or youtube:skip=hls,dash. The protocol selector excludes manifests from selection, not fetching. Parent post-run correction: upstream parses comma-separated skip values; the draft claim they were inert was incorrect. Raw timings are unchanged.
method.policy: This is a developer measurement. It changes no default, adds no persistence, no cache and no resident process, and it implies no caching policy.
method.post_run_review_note: All three wall median differences favor onedir (-14/-302/-228 ms); magnitudes vary and CPU differences have mixed signs. Three attempts per scenario do not establish a stable effect size.
method.pss_method: maximum sampled sum of process-tree PSS from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup
method.rss_method: maximum sampled sum of process-tree RSS over the whole tree; shared pages may be counted once per mapping process and short-lived spikes may be missed
method.solver_count_method: a shim in front of Bun logs every invocation; the runtime version probe is excluded
method.startup_method: new-process start of each binary (--version), interleaved, wall time and getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) delta. NOT a cold boot: the operating system page cache is warm after the first launch, so the first launch of each binary is reported separately.

frozen_cli.page_cache_state: the first launch may still read a cold page cache; every later launch reads a warm one. These are new-process measurements, not cold boots.

unpacked_zip.page_cache_state: the first launch may still read a cold page cache; every later launch reads a warm one. These are new-process measurements, not cold boots.
